note: Reactions to OpenAI’s 6 October release. Oxford’s Martin Bridson, president of the Clay Mathematics Institute, calls it “breathtaking” and adds: “We should embrace the power that the machines offer, but we should not be indentured to follow their lead.”
title: ‘Breathtaking,’ ‘Devastating’: Mathematics Reels After New OpenAI Release
who: Siobhan Roberts, The New York Times
